note: Community tab. The running total is a config constant that starts at zero — the app makes no claim about money given until money has been given. Votes are stored locally; there is no server. Text only, no logos bundled.

organisations.name: Islamic Relief Worldwide
organisations.blurb: Emergency response and long-term development in more than 40 countries, working through local offices rather than parachuting in.

organisations.name: Penny Appeal
organisations.blurb: Small, regular giving pooled into water, orphan care and food programmes, built around the idea that consistency beats size.

organisations.name: Human Appeal
